gloss: to grab, to grasp, to seize

definitions.explanation: To take hold of something firmly.
To capture an opportunity or understand something.

notes:
{掴|つか}む is a transitive verb meaning to grab or grasp firmly, both physically and figuratively.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive)
- Pattern: 〜を{掴|つか}む

PHYSICAL GRASPING:
- {手|て}を{掴|つか}む: to grab someone's hand
- ロープを{掴|つか}む: to grab a rope
- {襟|えり}を{掴|つか}む: to grab by the collar

FIGURATIVE USE:
- チャンスを{掴|つか}む: to seize an opportunity
- {心|こころ}を{掴|つか}む: to capture someone's heart
- {要点|ようてん}を{掴|つか}む: to grasp the main point
- {成功|せいこう}を{掴|つか}む: to achieve success

SIMILAR VERBS:
- {握|にぎ}る: to grip, hold (sustained holding)
- {取|と}る: to take (more general)
- {捕|つか}まえる: to catch, capture (person/animal)
